description: This file defines the TaxJarSettings class for managing tax settings in an ERP system, including methods for updating tax configurations, creating custom fields, managing permissions, and integrating with external tax regions.

classes.name: TaxJarSettings
classes.description: A class representing the settings for TaxJar integration, handling updates, validation, and nexus list management.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the settings are updated, such as creating custom fields and permissions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current settings before saving.

methods.name: update_nexus_list
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of nexus regions from the external client.

methods.name: calculate_taxes_validation_for_create_transactions
methods.description: Ensures that tax calculation is enabled before creating transactions.
